column1: # Ground truth for `contour similar`, against an rq checkout. Proposed
# format — see tests/eval/rails/similar.tsv for the row grammar.
# DRAFTED BY CLAUDE, NOT YET REVIEWED BY THE OWNER.
# The original rows probed the epoch-seconds family (now_secs / unix_now /
# now_unix); rq consolidated that family into core/clock.rs on 2026-08-27
# (7df14e2, "One clock, not four"), so those probes no longer resolve and
# were retired with the duplication they described. No replacement family of
# comparable shape exists in today's checkout; when one appears, source
# probes by reading, not from `similar`'s own output.
